notes: Each stored SVG is an unmodified complete provided asset; root width/height are preserved. No screenshot, entire component render, whole board or runtime UI image is used.
The native28 home/book/clock/search solids are a separate source family from AgentHubIcon16/20/24. Blue selected clock/home are actual instance paint overrides, not a global nav-icon color rewrite.

Byte-distinct exports with different Figma group IDs remain separate by context/source; seven exact SHA duplicate contexts share a record. Only provided source geometry is used, and no SVG paths/colors are edited.
svgLiteralColors can include white clipping/mask primitives; colors records actual source paint. Original source/native size and displayed/exported slot size are separate.

The source24 settings icon is displayed/exported20. Header chevron/direct/filter/plus use#656B74 rather than the shared source default#1C1C1C; source identity alone does not prove exact rendered paint equality.
Folder source3018:24833 retains the misspelled forder source name. Panel instances named icon/forder/16 may actually swap to chat source2320:15942; glyphSlots uses actual source identity.
One more glyph is a direct FRAME16, distinct from the source2751:16967 INSTANCE glyph. Use each whole supplied export rather than reconstructing paths or substituting source24 more.
The primary40 new-chat leading plus20 is white; trailing plus20 is hidden in the actual panel and its separate export is reference-only. Do not render hidden icons or reserve empty gaps.

Avatar letter/name and real project/chat labels are product data. Primitive divider/tree-line geometry, item gradient fades and panel bottom fade are layout/paint contracts, not raster runtime assets.
The1224px board, radius100 title presentation and40px demonstration gap are provenance only. Product rail+panel composition is a separate contract; do not ship the board as an image.
No existing asset manifest, product repository, Git state, skill installation or runtime component implementation is changed.
